recent.text: Final: Heat 123, Thunder 113 Miami has now won seven straight, including the third-straight wire-to-wire win — this one without Giannis Antetokounmpo

recent.text: FINAL: Heat 123, Thunder 113 - Adebayo 24pts/15reb/12ast - Larsson 21pts/3reb/5ast - Jović 15pts/8reb - Mitchell 14pts/4reb/3ast - Fontecchio 11pts - Portis 10pts/8reb - Conwell 10pts The Heat (10-6) have now won seven straight games. They play next in Philadelphia on Wednesday.

recent.text: And now he has 12 for a new career high in assists. Bam Adebayo up to 22 points, 15 rebounds, 12 assists, two blocks and two steals on the night. Heat now lead, 119-104, with 3:46 left.

recent.quoted_text: Bam's career high in assists is 11. He just matched that for the 6th time in his career.
